listing.name: Terminal49
listing.description: Terminal49 helps users find and monitor ocean shipments and containers, filter and count their container worklists (by status, terminal, carrier, holds, last free day, arrival, or company), inspect routes and transport events, check supported shipping lines, and, where trade intelligence is enabled, research US ocean import markets (importers, products, origins, ports, and carriers). At the user's request it can also track containers, stop or resume tracking, cancel pending tracking requests, and set parties and custom field values on containers and shipments. Changes that remove or replace data show a preview first and run only after the user confirms.

primary_use_cases: Find and monitor ocean shipments and containers
Filter and count container worklists by status, terminal, carrier, holds, last free day, or company
Stop or resume shipment tracking and cancel pending tracking requests
Set parties and custom field values on containers and shipments
Research US ocean import markets: importers, products, origin countries, ports, and carriers
